obligations.title: Identity of the completed RT whole
Typed composition or recursion of complete RT wholes
Projection from SymmetryCondition into legal operand domains
Canonical projection and result selection for deterministic semantics
Define typed equivalence sufficient for operand substitution

axioms.purpose: Specify whether the relation is order-sensitive and define legal operand ordering.
axioms.statement: The SymmetryConditionRelation is well-formed only when its left operand is BoundedSymmetry and its right operand is UnboundedSymmetry.
axioms.well_formed_rule: WellFormed(a | b) iff TypeOf(a) = BoundedSymmetry and TypeOf(b) = UnboundedSymmetry

axioms.purpose: Specify admissible operand types and required type validation.
axioms.statement: The relation admits exactly a BoundedSymmetry left operand and an UnboundedSymmetry right operand; a generic SymmetryCondition is not silently coerced into either subtype.
axioms.type_rule: Admissible(a | b) iff TypeOf(a) = BoundedSymmetry and TypeOf(b) = UnboundedSymmetry

axioms.purpose: Define identity behavior if an identity exists.
axioms.statement: No identity element is applicable to the typed SymmetryConditionRelation; identity is not an operator-local property of |.

axioms.purpose: Define when equivalent operands may be substituted.
axioms.statement: No substitution between distinct operands is permitted; only canonical self-reference and governed alias expansion are allowed.

axioms.purpose: Define relation composition and closure rules.
axioms.statement: Self-composition is not applicable to | because its SymmetryCondition codomain is not a declared input operand domain.

axioms.purpose: Determine whether closure over SymmetryCondition holds.
axioms.statement: The relation is not closed over either operand domain, their union, or generic SymmetryCondition; whole-RT closure remains separate.

axioms.purpose: Define invalid operand combinations and required failure results.
axioms.statement: Malformed relation expressions are rejected before evaluation with validation-only MalformedConstruction diagnostics; they are not false propositions or SymmetryCondition values.

axioms.purpose: Require identical outputs for identical admissible inputs.
axioms.statement: Parsing, typing, well-formedness, alias resolution, and malformed diagnostics are deterministic; semantic-result and complete executable determinism remain blocked by missing projection selection and executable semantics.

axioms.purpose: Explicitly prove, reject, or mark associativity inapplicable.
axioms.statement: Associativity is inapplicable to | because its result is SymmetryCondition rather than a legal operand type, so neither iterated parenthesization is generally well typed.

axioms.purpose: Explicitly prove, reject, or mark commutativity inapplicable.
axioms.statement: Commutativity is inapplicable because the reversed expression violates the declared BoundedSymmetry × UnboundedSymmetry operand order; noncommutativity is not established.

axioms.purpose: Specify the complete admissible input domain.
Define compatibility requirements for downstream projection operators.
